excerpt: Congratulations to Dan and Lindsay!  The reception at Pinehurst was elegant and FUN!  Everybody had a great time dancing, making requests and celebrating Dan and Lindsay’s union of marriage.  Good luck to the happy couple!   DJ Matt Hong
